memory_candidates.content: lean4 plan authoring gotcha for `lean-challenge-snapshot.sh`: the Goals identifier range is `sed -n -E '/^-? ?\*\*Goals\*\*:/,/^-? ?\*\*[^G]/p'`, so (1) the header must be exactly `**Goals**:` with the colon directly after the bold (a parenthetical before the colon makes the range empty, exit 71 'no identifiers'); (2) EVERY backticked name in prose inside that range is extracted as a Goal, so keep namespace names and file paths unbackticked there and end the range with a bold-led line such as `**Non-Goals**:` before any explanatory paragraph; (3) `def`/`abbrev` declarations in the `## Lean Challenge Statements` block ARE counted as declared identifiers and must be listed under Goals too. Dry-run `lean-challenge-snapshot.sh N <root> --dry-run` at plan time to confirm exit 0 before writing success metadata.
